context_requirements: Functional T-type calcium channel expression (CACNA1G/H/I) and dependence on T-type calcium influx for cell-cycle progression
Proliferating cells with intact G1/S checkpoint machinery
Sufficient exposure at 10 micromolar to achieve channel blockade and downstream cell-cycle effects
falsifiers: No change in proliferation or G1-arrest markers at 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
No reduction in CCND1, CDK2, CDK4, CDK6, CCNE2, or other G1/S genes at 24 h
No increase in CDKN1A or CDKN1B at 24 h
Clear transcriptional response at 6 h inconsistent with slow cell-cycle-mediated effects

evidence.supports: T-type calcium channel blocker KCP10043F causes G1-phase arrest in A549 cells with downregulation of CDK2, CDK4, CDK6, cyclin D2, cyclin D3, and cyclin E, and upregulation of p27KIP1.
Selective T-type calcium channel blocker mibefradil has presumed mechanism of G1 arrest in high-grade gliomas.
